Implemented and verified all three improvements:

- Pasting a URL now automatically fetches its page title and description. Favicons are derived from the detected domain.
- Added permanent deletion with a confirmation dialog, separate from archive and restore.
- Tags are clickable and open a filtered view; the active tag can be cleared from the toolbar.
- Metadata failures fall back gracefully to manual entry without blocking saving.
- Confirmed the production build and browser interactions work.

Updated app: **http://maker:4000**
